description:
This is a special notice of The Virginia Contracting Activity (VACA) release of a DIA SCIF Lifecycle Support Services RFI on NRO and NSA ARCs. 

Please take note of the following:

 - RFI submission deadline: April 09, 2026, at 23:59 PM (EST)

- All qualified entities wishing to respond to the Request for Information (RFI) must comply with the instructions outlined in the NRO and NSA ARC postings.

- Additionally, access to the NRO and NSA ARC is a prerequisite for RFI submissions.
